records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The Company's quarterly financial data is subject to seasonal fluctuations, and its second and third quarter financial results have historically reflected higher travel demand than its first and fourth quarter financial results.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: In the nine months ended September 30, 2025 and 2024, the Company recognized approximately $5.8 billion and $5.2 billion, respectively, of passenger revenue for tickets that were included in Advance ticket sales at the beginning of those periods.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Republic currently operates 66 regional aircraft under capacity purchase agreements ("CPAs") with United that have terms through 2037.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Passenger revenue increased $254 million, or 1.9%, in the third quarter of 2025 as compared to the year-ago period, primarily due to a 7.2% increase in capacity and a 6.2% increase in the number of passengers flown, partially offset by a 4.0% decrease in yield.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Other operating revenue increased $114 million, or 13.2%, in the third quarter of 2025 as compared to the year-ago period, primarily due to an increase in mileage revenue from non-airline partners, including credit card spending with our co-branded credit card partner, JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A., as well as an increase in the purchases of United Club memberships.
